data.why: cell-count.csv and cell_counts.db are already checked into the repo root and the dashboard reads them directly with no upload step; the dashboard also rebuilds cell_counts.db from cell-count.csv automatically if it's missing, so nothing needs to be copied or synthesized.

goals: Inspect a single sample's immune cell population composition (b_cell, cd8_t_cell, cd4_t_cell, nk_cell, monocyte) as percentages of total cell count
Compare the average population composition across all samples
Determine whether any immune cell population's relative frequency distinguishes miraclib responders from non-responders, using Mann-Whitney U / Welch's t-test with FDR correction and effect size
Filter the responder-comparison cohort by condition, treatment, and sample type to explore other subgroups
Characterize the baseline (time = 0) melanoma/PBMC/miraclib subset by project, response, and sex
Compute the average B cell count for melanoma male responders at baseline across all sample types and treatments

review.summary: The tree is accurate and follows the README's three questions: per-sample composition, whether any population predicts miraclib response (with FDR and effect size), and the baseline cohort and B-cell mean. All 14 tasks and 5 features were replayed, and every screen I sampled supports its node. The gaps are minor: there is no figure-export step, the primary-test distinction is not made explicit, and the bar chart has no feature. It can be filed as is, and the listed polish is optional.
